status: pre-registered, not yet run on GEMS input data
hypothesis: Line-like responses supported by DEM curvature and at least one potential-field gradient, with H0 persistence greater than 2 epsilon at at least two adjacent smoothing scales, rank above single-scale threshold artifacts at matched prediction budget.

layers.magnetic: metadata-identified total magnetic intensity or reduced-to-pole magnetic anomaly

transform.dem: mask-aware Gaussian smoothing then scale-normalized Hessian anisotropy
transform.magnetic: mask-aware Gaussian smoothing then scale-normalized horizontal gradient magnitude
transform.gravity: mask-aware Gaussian smoothing then scale-normalized horizontal gradient magnitude
transform.constant_response_rule: if the fitted response 99.5th percentile is not above its median, use zero response

persistence.filtration: superlevel sets of robustly normalized nonnegative ridge/edge response

fusion.layer_aggregation: arithmetic mean of positive persistence-weighted family scores where minimum layer support is met
fusion.scale_aggregation: maximum persistence-weighted response over the configured scales
fusion.normalization: robust percentiles per field; output score is a rank signal, not a calibrated probability

evaluation.truth: public catalogue labels used only for a spatial pseudo-holdout; not the expert-only hidden fault truth
evaluation.guard_interpretation: Validation-only boundary guard to reduce cross-block metric-kernel leakage; not an organizer scoring buffer. It also means this pseudo-holdout does not test corrections or splays within 300 m of a visible known trace.
evaluation.known_fault_mask_rule: Apply the organizer-confirmed exact provided training-fault pixel mask only; no proximity buffer. New/corrected/splayed fault truth may occur within 300 m of known traces. In each spatial fold, only catalogue pixels outside the full held-out quadrant are visible-known; the held-out quadrant labels are withheld.
evaluation.aggregation: Sum TP, FP, and FN over all four non-overlapping evaluation blocks, then calculate one pooled DTI; per-fold DTIs are descriptive and used only for paired-regression safeguards.
evaluation.normalization_fit_scope: Within each fold, fit robust input and response percentiles on the other three full quadrants only; apply those fixed transforms across the complete unsupervised feature grid. No catalogue labels enter fit masks or transformations.
evaluation.budget_source: Fixed count reported for the owner-side H33-2-B2 artifact in the supplied GEMSDOE32 project record. The artifact-to-organizer-score association is unverified; this count is used only as a fixed matched-budget comparator, never as a pixel source.
evaluation.top_budget_rule: For each fold, omit only exact visible-known fault pixels from candidate eligibility; no distance dilation. Select exactly k highest positive ranking scores; ties resolved by ascending row-major flat index; emit binary 1/0 values. For the eventual full-grid map, omit exact provided training-fault pixels only.
evaluation.primary_control: single-scale DEM-curvature + magnetic-edge + gravity-edge ranking at sigma=2 pixels
evaluation.historical_control_status: H33-2-B2 is excluded as a fold-wise promotion comparator: its B=2 catalogue-buffer pruning used labels from the complete area, including held-out quadrants, and would leak holdout truth into the fixed baseline. Its owner-reported leaderboard association is not organizer-verified.
evaluation.current_holdout_best_registration_rule: Before any weekly slot, register a hash-pinned local holdout report with identical raw input hashes, metric, fold/guard protocol, exact mask rule, matched pixel budget, and a validation-protocol digest covering the validator, metric, and fold/budget implementation hashes. If no compatible current-best report is registered, the slot gate fails closed.

submission_format.grid: exact sample-submission dimensions, CRS, and affine transform
submission_format.all_stored_cells: single-band float32 finite values in [0,1]; current local writer omits a nodata tag
submission_format.outside_footprint_encoding: not verified against an authenticated competition template or portal; do not claim the conservative local policy is organizer-confirmed
submission_format.known_fault_pixels: may be zero; they are excluded exactly by the organizer mask and do not justify suppressing nearby pixels

important_limits: H0 persistence tracks births and deaths of connected components in superlevel sets of a scalar response; it does not prove line-shaped geometry or geological fault identity.

The persistence theorem certifies diagram stability conditional on epsilon for each fixed transformed scalar field; epsilon=0.01 is a preregistered assumption, not an empirically measured perturbation bound.
Spatial matching of bars across Gaussian sigmas is heuristic; it has no formal multiparameter stability claim.
The public-catalogue spatial holdout is not a direct proxy for hidden new faults, especially near known traces, and does not predict the private leaderboard.
Parameters are fixed before the input rasters are available; changes after observing holdout results require a new preregistration and untouched evaluation data.
No current holdout-best baseline report, authenticated competition raster, validated result, or eligible submission exists in the workspace.
